notes: ACCESS: robots.txt (www.xxxlutz.de/robots.txt) has no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web disallow and no blanket 'Disallow: /'; site allows tier (a). Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch via curl_cffi impersonate=chrome124 (Cloudflare-fronted site; plain urllib got 403 on robots.txt, curl_cffi with Chrome TLS impersonation succeeded on every page, SSR HTML fully populated, so no Playwright/tier-b escalation was needed). A handful of individual page requests returned an empty JS-required shell (~4.4KB) or hit transient decode/connection errors on the first attempt; all were resolved on retry (2nd-6th attempt) with the same curl_cffi approach, consistent with intermittent Cloudflare rate-limiting rather than a hard block, so no CAPTCHA/anti-bot wall was ever encountered and tier (c) was not needed. TREE METHOD: union of (1) main nav flyout on homepage -> 'Deko & Textil' (/c/wohnaccessoires) which lists the top-level nodes Wohntextilien(C83)/Schlaftextilien(C81)/Badtextilien(C82)/Teppiche&Boeden(C11)/Ordnen&Aufbewahren(C26)/Badaccessoires(C27) among others; (2) each of those category pages' own categoryList sub-nav tiles, recursed down to 4-5 levels deep where the site itself further splits a node (e.g. Bettwaesche by weave/material, Fertiggardinen by curtain type, Rollos by blind type) until a page showed zero further sub-nav tiles (confirmed leaf); (3) sitemap-categories.xml (5671 URLs) cross-checked via keyword grep (bettwaesche/gardine/teppich/aufbewahrung/koerbe/regal etc.) to confirm no additional 4th/5th-level nodes were missed. Every recorded leaf's h1 and breadcrumb JSON (GraphQL SSR payload) were confirmed to match the requested node/code before its qty was recorded. QTY METHOD: exact integer read from the SSR-embedded GraphQL payload field pagination.totalResults (e.g. "pagination":{...,"totalResults":3593}) on each leaf's own rendered page - not estimated, not aggregated from siblings; every value differs across categories confirming it is per-category, not a repeated fallback. EXCLUDED as hardware/non-textile: Gardinenschienen, Gardinen-Stangen, Vorhangzubehoer, Raffhalter (curtain rails/rods/accessories/tiebacks), Jalousien (venetian blinds - rigid slats not fabric). EXCLUDED as accessory/underlay not the textile product itself: Teppichunterlagen (rug underlay pads), matching the established Wayfair-precedent rug-pad exclusion. EXCLUDED cross-listed duplicate nodes reachable from a second nav path but sharing the same canonical URL as a node already recorded once (Kopfkissen&Nackenkissen and Bettdecken cross-linked from the Kissen/Decken tiles; Kissenbezuege cross-linked from both Kissen and Beze paths - kept once under its canonical Bezuege parent; Duschvorhaenge cross-linked from Badaccessoires - kept once under Badtextilien). EXCLUDED from Storage as pure bathroom fixtures/hardware/decor, not storage/organization product: Seifenspender, Zahnputzbecher, Kosmetik-/Abfalleimer, Handtuchhaken, Seifenschalen, Taschentuchboxen, Foehnhalter, Schminkspiegel (Waschplatzzubehoer siblings), Handtuchhalter, Duschabzieher, Wanneneinlagen, Badhocker (Duschzubehoer siblings), all of WC Ausstattung (Toilettenpapierhalter/WC Buerstengarnituren/WC Sitze - fixtures), Spardosen (piggy banks - decorative/toy, not storage). MOVED from Storage to Textile per textile.md rule 12/21 (fabric protective covers are Textile, not Storage): Gartenmoebel-Schutzhuellen and Sonnenschirmhuellen, both children of the mixed 'Aufbewahrung & Schutzhuellen' (C73) garden-storage group - the same group name is used once in each array since its children genuinely split across both categories. LOW/MEDIUM confidence rows (Coasters/Untersetzer material unconfirmed; Pillow Fillings; Cocktail Table Covers; Storage Tins/Chests/Newspaper Stand/Cosmetic Storage Tins/Equipment Cabinets/Garden Tool Sheds/Bike Storage Shelters/Multi-Purpose Cabinets - all borderline decorative-vs-storage or furniture-vs-storage calls per storage.md Sec 42 ambiguity handling) are flagged rather than silently guessed either way. No Furniture/Lighting/Kitchen&Dining/Wall Decor/Decorative Accessories/Bathroom-fixture nodes were included.
